articles.summary: The Tiptap AI Toolkit brings a Cursor-like workflow to text editors, giving AI agents a real editing interface for structured documents.
articles.title: Introducing Tiptap AI Toolkit beta

articles.summary: Tiptap now includes an open-source Markdown extension. Parse Markdown into Tiptap’s JSON format and serialize rich text back to Markdown. Fully bidirectional, extensible, and CommonMark-compliant.
articles.title: Introducing bidirectional Markdown support in Tiptap
